annotation.title_clean: 旅客自動車運送事業運輸規則
annotation.title_en: Passenger Motor Vehicle Transport Business Transport Regulations
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japan's 1956 ministerial ordinance on passenger motor vehicle transport operators, current revision effective 1 October 2026. Mostly conventional bus and taxi operation rules, with provisions on specified automated operation passenger transport requiring safety attendants (onboard or remote), emergency stop devices, and attendant duties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators of specified automated passenger transport must always appoint enough specified automated operation safety attendants (Art. 15-2).
Automated vehicles need an onboard attendant, or passenger emergency contact and stop devices plus remote monitoring by a stationed attendant.
Operators must maintain systems to carry out safety measures for automated operation and respond to incidents, giving priority to saving passengers' lives.
Roll calls must check automated driving device settings for safety attendants.
Operators must have damage compensation measures meeting MLIT notified standards.
